name: Middle Fork Snoqualmie River
gaugeName: Middle Fork Snoqualmie River near Tanner
blurb: Clear mountain river under Mt. Si and Russian Butte, a half hour from Seattle.

sections.notes: Upper Middle. Several Class II+ rapids; wood shifts every year — trip reports mention trees requiring a portage. King County lists a public hand-boat access just below the Concrete Bridge with road-shoulder parking; no pass is stated. Bridge View fee status not confirmed.

sections.notes: Middle-Middle. Mostly Class III with House Rocks (Class IV) at AW mile ~5. Experienced paddlers only. King County lists a public hand-boat access just below the Concrete Bridge with road-shoulder parking; no pass is stated. At Tanner use only the designated parking (AW).
